title: The Charisma Myth
author: Olivia Fox Cabane

chosenEdition.name: The Charisma Myth: How Anyone Can Master the Art and Science of Personal Magnetism
chosenEdition.format: current official English paperback / digital family
chapterStructure: The Obstacles to Presence, Power, and Warmth

alternativesConsidered.name: 2012 Portfolio/Penguin original hardcover family
alternativesConsidered.notes: Older visible chapter map ends with The Charismatic Life: Rising to the Challenge and does not surface Digital Charisma, making it materially different at the chapter-package level.

alternativesConsidered.name: 2012 Penguin ebook family
alternativesConsidered.notes: Google Books exposes an earlier 272-page Penguin package with a different late-book structure. It is treated as an older family rather than the current official lock.

decisionRationale: The current author site, the current Google Books preview page, and Penguin Random House metadata converge on the present official English family built around the 2013 Portfolio package.
That current family supports the chapter map used for this run, including Digital Charisma as the late-book digital/online chapter.
The 2012 records expose a materially different earlier chapter map, so they cannot be blended with the current family.
Because the current official family is visible across official-author and publisher-facing sources, no user edition question is required.
